facts.text: Sisseton takes its name from the Sisseton division of the Sioux people, honoring the tribe that first settled the area.
The city proudly serves as the county seat of Roberts County, hosting the county courthouse and administrative offices.
Tourists can climb the historic Nicollet Tower, a landmark that offers sweeping views of the town and surrounding plains.
Sisseton experiences a dry, four‑season climate with long, cold winters, hot summers, and brief spring and autumn transitions.
Sisseton Wahpeton College, part of the Sisseton Wahpeton Oyate, is a small college located just outside the city in Agency Village.
The town celebrates a rich Native American and immigrant heritage, welcoming visitors with friendly locals and a sense of historic pride.
